name: Meinklang
article: Meinklang is a family-run mixed farm on the eastern side of Lake Neusiedl, close to Hungary. Wine growing sits alongside fruit trees, other crops and livestock. Its cattle contribute fertilizer for the vineyards, connecting the different parts of the farm. The producer also works with unpruned vines and egg-shaped concrete vessels for some wines.

name: Joe Chandellier
article: Joe Chandellier farms 13 hectares around Souvignargues in the Gard and bottles under IGP Gard. The merchant's page for Alluvions Blanc 2025 describes a direct-pressed blend from young vines on clay and silt: 70% Viognier, 20% Cinsaut and 10% Rolle.
